An '''unidentified creature''' resembling a [[Frog/Legends|frog]] resided within a river on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], where it was was seen on top of a [[victoria]] which an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] used as a makeshift cover with a reed to act as breathing tube while swimming underwater, although the Ewok collided with a rock, causing the frog to quickly jump off the pad into the water.<ref name="2-14" />
